mechanism_analysis.dominant_source_ident.reason: Actual channel-isolated runs show depolarization dominates the noninteracting bias, while relaxation/dephasing is slightly larger in the interacting cases. failure_analysis.subsection_present.reason: Section 5 explicitly discusses numerical failures and physical degradation, including quadrature instability, low endpoint visibility, and circular-error re-entry at high noise.

failure_analysis.patterns_explained_cohe.reason: The report links low-visibility instability to the atan2 readout, high-noise apparent recoveries to phase winding, integrated drift to asymmetric noisy preparation histories, and quadrature failures to rapidly varying redundant coordinates.
